in_hebrew.name: Edric
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Edric הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'Ead' meaning 'wealth' and 'ric' meaning 'ruler'. The name Edric signifies a wealthy and powerful leader in ancient English culture.

in_greek.name: Edric
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Wealthy ruler
in_greek.long_meaning: Edric είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English 'Ead' meaning 'wealth' and 'ric' meaning 'ruler'. The name Edric signifies a wealthy and powerful leader in ancient English culture.

in_latin.name: Edricus
in_latin.long_meaning: Edricus est nomen theodori, officialis, quod significat officium. Nomen huius generis fuit in usu antiquus, et in lingua Latina. Deinde, in lingua Anglica, nomen huius generis fuit Edric, quod significat officium. Hoc nomen in lingua Hebraica, Graeca, et Latina in usu est. Nomen huius generis est officiale, sed etiam theodori, quod significat officium. Hoc nomen est in usu antiquo, et in lingua Latina.
